j.desc: Draw JC as a SIX-YEAR-OLD Dominican-American boy in 2007. Family facial landmarks: light brown skin, dark almond eyes, uneven brows, short dark curls. Strongly childlike anatomy, approximately five heads tall, soft round child cheeks, short limbs, small hands, absolutely no stubble or mature jaw, headphones or electronics. Curious alert face. Plain faded blue crew-neck long-sleeve shirt, dark school trousers, worn sneakers. Neutral three-quarter standing pose, arms apart slightly; full natural color source, PRESS treatment will be applied in compositing.
